profile.headline: Software Engineer II @ Microsoft Azure
profile.summary: Working on all things related to networking, observability and security for containerized workloads as part of the Azure Container Networking team at Microsoft. I graduated from Boston University with a BA/MS dual degree in Computer Science and a minor in Linguistics. My interests lie in distributed systems and networking.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Working on all things related to networking, observability and security for containerized workloads as part of the Azure Container Networking team, including but not limited to:
‣ Azure Container Networking Service (Azure CNS)
‣ Azure CNI
‣ Retina: Open-source eBPF-powered L3/L4 observability platform for Kubernetes
‣ Cilium
‣ Advanced Container Networking Services (ACNS): Observability and Security on AKS
